dispatcher.whenToUse: Route and assign work. I classify the goal, set priority, record ownership and confidence, and name the next role. No goal skips dispatch.

builder.whenToUse: Produce durable artefacts. I write code, documents, schemas, and configurations, then self-validate before handing off to the Verifier.

runtime.whenToUse: Operate live systems. I deploy, migrate, scale, restart, and configure, and I keep a tested rollback plan inside the safe tier.

verifier.whenToUse: Independent validation gate. I define the green gate, re-run evidence where possible, and post a verdict before integration or deployment.

researcher.whenToUse: Reduce uncertainty. I gather context, surface alternatives with trade-offs, and land findings the team can act on.

archivist.whenToUse: Maintain the durable record. I append, index, and surface recurring lessons so the team can retrieve context and turn it into skills.
